description: Unsigned transactions to buy Monday-gap cover on a stock while the market is shut (until an hour before the reopen): side up pays if the first feed print after the reopen is more than the strike above the last print (cover for a short), down if it is more than the strike below (for a long); it pays the move beyond the strike, times the cover, up to the pool's cap. Approve exactly the premium, then buy with that premium as the most it may take. Simulated from the wallet.

notional.description: Cover, in USDG: for a short, about what the shares are worth, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

side.description: up (pays on a gap up: for a short) or down (on a gap down: for a long)

strike_bps.description: How far the stock must move before it pays, in hundredths of a percent: 100, 200, 300 or 500 are quoted (default 200, 2%)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: buy_cover
title: Prepare: buy gap cover
